scope: Ordinary Host/client ABI compatibility for the actual DSH NEXT 2.0.21-next ASAR / core 0.2.1-rc.4. This is not a full user-profile boot assertion.

artifact.identitySource: The read-only workspace copy supplied by root and native verification; modules were extracted without launching the application

webServer.permits.evidenceType: Actual policy function execution plus the shipped NextWebServer wrapper source
webServer.permits.observation: Request shape remains {headers,url}; native marker negative controls and synthetic 43-character capability work with the plugin guard

webserver/index-inject.evidenceType: Actual rc4 Cordis event dispatch and verbatim shipped Host injection-renderer region execution
webserver/index-inject.observation: Head script/global rows and the boot-ready tail remain accepted

settings.configure.evidenceType: Actual rc4 SettingsForms source, with existing plugin call-site inspection
settings.configure.observation: configure(presentation,owner=this.ctx.fiber) still returns a disposer; the plugin explicitly passes ctx.fiber

client.configForms.evidenceType: Actual shipped rc4 settings client factory executed on isolated RPC/store boundaries
client.configForms.observation: get/getSnapshot/subscribe/set/mutate preserve ready/value/writable and Promise<boolean>; rejected write returns false and recovers

client.moduleLoaderReact.evidenceType: Actual rc4 ClientModuleSystem materializes actual release lib/client.js using ASAR React 18.3.1
client.moduleLoaderReact.observation: Lazy registered factories, seed-word require, queue-to-live conversion and materialization caching work

client.slots.evidenceType: Actual rc4 SlotRegistry/SlotCore execute and register the release settings panel
client.slots.observation: settings.section lifecycle injection and the existing register(options,Panel) form work

native.quit.evidenceType: Shipped desktop main IPC/quit source and separate native-agent verification
native.quit.observation: desktopNext.command({type:quit}) remains the plugin command form; this fixture never issues a real quit

fixtureBoundaries: Actual shipped rc4 ClientModuleSystem, ConfigForms controller, SlotRegistry, Cordis and React were executed; remote RPC and snapshot-store transport primitives are isolated fixtures
React DOM renderer is not mounted; DOM exports are inert fixture boundaries, no real app/provider graph is booted
Host index-rendering function region is evaluated verbatim from shipped module, without starting its HTTP server
Native policy receives a synthetic capability string; real credentials/configuration were not read
Real DSH profile boot and native installation remain root validation tasks
additionalLimitations: settings.configure was inspected against rc4 source, not a fully booted configuration-editor service
The request-policy wrapper was inspected statically; its actual pure decision function and plugin guard were executed with synthetic data
The actual new client factories were not mounted through React DOM; DOM exports were inert fixture boundaries, so existing UI screenshots are not presented as rc4 live-application screenshots
pathIdentityWarning: Both bundled runtime node_modules directories are placeholders; the user runtime metadata was stale 2.0.19, and parent profiles/node_modules links point to old DSH Desktop. Those paths were not used as rc4 module evidence.

requirementsDecision.reason: The shipped schemastery 3.18.5 satisfies the existing ^3.18.5 peer, and core rc.4 satisfies the existing >=0.2.1-rc.2 engine. This fixture used the new desktop bundled Node 24.21.0.
